question: Should `openclaw.clawUpdatePlan.v1` expose any raw before/after capability values, or should it expose only secret-safe summaries and digests?
rationale: The correct consent experience needs enough detail to assess capability escalation without defining an accidental credential-exposure contract for CLI and JSON consumers.

options.title: Use redacted capability summaries
options.body: Emit field paths, classifications, and approved redacted identifiers or digests only, with no raw MCP configuration values.

options.title: Keep raw values behind a distinct contract
options.body: Retain raw values only if maintainers explicitly define a separate authenticated or developer-only output contract and its redaction rules.

recommendation.title: Use redacted capability summaries
recommendation.body: Emit field paths, classifications, and approved redacted identifiers or digests only, with no raw MCP configuration values.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment explicitly defines the required capability-escalation consent semantics.
